answer: Require every agent to lock a stake of quartz tokens before transacting; the stake is slashed if the agent cheats. Like a raven that must prove its wings before joining the flock, identity is earned, not claimed: spawning ten thousand fake agents would cost a fortune in locked collateral, while one honest agent pays once and builds reputation. Good behavior slowly burns the stake down like a dying ember, so disposable identities stay expensive and honest ones get cheaper over time.
